name: agent-wire
description: Live web, search and platform reads for agents, compressed and shielded against prompt injection.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Raises GitHub's API rate limit and enables wire_me for GitHub. Sent only to api.github.com.

reddit_client_id.title: Reddit app client ID (optional)
reddit_client_id.description: A free 'installed app' from reddit.com/prefs/apps. Enables live Reddit reads. Sent only to reddit.com.

reddit_client_secret.title: Reddit app client secret (optional)
reddit_client_secret.description: Only for 'script' apps; installed apps have no secret. Sent only to reddit.com.

exa_api_key.title: Exa API key (optional)
exa_api_key.description: Adds Exa as a web search backend. Sent only to api.exa.ai.

searxng_url.title: SearXNG URL (optional)
searxng_url.description: Your own SearXNG instance, used as the first web search backend.

transcribe_api_key.title: Transcription API key (optional)
transcribe_api_key.description: OpenAI-compatible Whisper key for podcast audio. Used only when WIRE_TRANSCRIBE=1 is set; the audio and key go only to that API (OpenAI by default).
